title: Services chrome and blocks: header, footer, hero variants and the function blocks
detail:
Plan step 5: ServicesHero (glow|photo|split|minimal), Trust, Services, Booking, Story, Steps, Reviews, Gallery, Plans, Events, Shop, Team, Library, Locations, Contact, Letter, FAQ, Band; header bar|pill|centered and footer full|minimal. Live blocks read Frequency rows like NetworkEvents; empty copy on every list block; tokens only, no literal colours. Two PRs under the 40-file gate.

Chrome (3 headers, 2 footers), the 18 blocks and the services skin exist as standalone modules with draw tests. Follow-up in LIVE-2040: register them, inject the skin, and wire the booking, events, shop, plans and posts blocks to Frequency rows.
